title: EPA Upholds 4 ppt PFOA & PFOS Drinking Water Limits While Proposing 2031 Extension
summary: The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency proposed upholding its strict 4 parts-per-trillion federal limits for PFOA and PFOS in drinking water. At the same time, the agency proposed giving public water utilities two extra years—until 2031—to meet full compliance.
detail: Under the May 2026 proposed rule, the federal Maximum Contaminant Levels (MCLs) for PFOA and PFOS remain enforceable at 4 parts per trillion, while eligible drinking water systems may request an extension from April 2029 to April 2031.

Separately, the EPA proposed rescinding federal regulations for four other PFAS compounds (PFHxS, PFNA, GenX, and PFBS mixtures), prompting many homeowners to rely on IAPMO NSF/ANSI 53 certified point-of-use reverse osmosis filters in the interim.

title: Global Ductless Mini-Split HVAC Market Reaches $19.4 Billion in 2026
summary: Industry analysis estimates the global ductless mini-split market at $19.40 billion in 2026, driven by residential heat-pump retrofits. Single-zone systems now represent roughly 59.7% of total market share as homeowners target room-by-room efficiency.
detail: The global ductless mini-splits market is projected to grow at an 8.5% compound annual growth rate from 2026 through 2033, reaching $34.42 billion as households replace older fossil-fuel furnaces with inverter heat pumps.

Major HVAC manufacturers have expanded North American ductless lines in 2026, making proper BTU sizing (20–25 BTUs per sq ft) and regular 4-to-6-week filter cleaning essential for preserving rated SEER2 efficiency.

title: Mandatory B2B E-Invoicing Expands Across Europe Ahead of 2027 Rollouts
summary: As of November 2026, mandatory B2B electronic invoicing is live in France, Poland, Belgium, Italy, Romania, Croatia, and Greece. Germany and Spain will follow with staggered small-business deadlines starting in 2027 and 2028.
detail: Large and mid-sized companies in France entered live B2B e-invoicing in September 2026, while SMEs and micro-enterprises must begin issuing compliant electronic invoices by September 2027.

For small service firms and cross-border agencies, adopting cloud invoicing tools like Zoho Invoice or FreshBooks early helps standardize structured invoice formats, automated tax reporting, and faster payment collection.

title: HVAC & Service Contractors Shift to Automated Quote Follow-Up & Mobile CRMs
summary: Field-service contractors in 2026 are increasingly replacing paper estimates with mobile CRMs that automate missed-call text-backs and quote follow-ups. Owner-led shops prioritize fast request-to-payment workflows over complex enterprise suites.
detail: Industry comparisons show growing adoption of tiered field-service software—ranging from Jobber and specialized HVAC CRMs to mobile-first platforms like QuoteIQ—to prevent unfollowed estimates from slipping through the cracks.
Automated SMS reminders, on-site card capture, and QuickBooks sync are now standard expectations even for 1-to-5 truck plumbing, HVAC, and exterior-cleaning crews.
